chunks: From him, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, meaning Ibn 'Abd Allah, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who is praying, then notices blood on his garment, he said: “He completes [the prayer].”
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: What is meant in it is when the blood is less than the amount of a dirham.

key_terms.الدَّمُ: the blood in question for the ruling
key_terms.مِقْدَارِ دِرْهَمٍ: the legal threshold of a dirham’s measure

ai.seo_question: If someone sees blood on his clothing during salat (prayer), should he continue or repeat the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who notices blood on his garment during salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام states that he completes the prayer, and Shaykh al-Tusi clarifies that this applies when the blood is less than the measure of a dirham.
